title: The p-root quotient is base change by a finite purely inseparable field
statement: Let $k$ be a field of prime characteristic $p$, $A$ a commutative $k$-algebra, $n\ge0$, and $a:\operatorname{Fin}n\to k$ with independent differentials in $\Omega_{k/\mathbf F_p}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. There is a field $F$ in universe $\max(u,v)$ with a $k$-algebra structure, finite and purely inseparable over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], such that the actual quotient $A[X_i]/(X_i^p-a_i)$ [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-algebra-local] is isomorphic as an $A$-algebra to $A\otimes_k F$.

source.place: Tag 07E5, proof of (2) => (4), first paragraph; Algebra 07DZ; monic division for the reduced-monomial bound. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07E5 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07DZ (local checkout absent).

proof.text: Use the actual quotient Q over k. The field-quotient theorem gives its field property, finiteness, and p-th powers in k. The purely inseparable power criterion with exponent one gives pure inseparability. Lift Q to F=ULift Q; the canonical equivalence transports finiteness and pure inseparability. All data are constructed from Q; no arbitrary witness is chosen from an unproved existence theorem.

Apply the tensor quotient equivalence to A tensor_k Q. The polynomial tensor equivalence identifies A tensor_k k[X_i] with A[X_i]. Map the defining ideal: the image of each generator is X_i^p-C(a_i), as verified using the pure-tensor formula. Ideal.map_span and the quotient algebra equivalence identify the quotient with the actual p-root quotient over A. Finally tensor the ULift equivalence to obtain A tensor_k F.

theorem pthRootAlgebra_equiv_field_baseChange
    (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → k) :
    letI := ZMod.algebra k p
    LinearIndependent k (fun i ↦ KaehlerDifferential.D (ZMod p) k (a i)) →
    ∃ (F : Type (max u v)) (hF : Field F),
      letI := hF
      ∃ (hAlg : Algebra k F),
        letI := hAlg
        Module.Finite k F ∧ IsPurelyInseparable k F ∧
          Nonempty (pthRootAlgebra p n A (fun i ↦ algebraMap k A (a i)) ≃ₐ[A]
            (A ⊗[k] F))
